name: Dhaka
blurb: Bangladesh’s capital: 470,000 mapped buildings, MRT Line 6 on 1500 V DC, and a long humid summer of air conditioners.

name: Delhi
blurb: A 20-million city that peaks in the afternoon heat: 8.7 GW, the highest of any Indian city.

name: Karachi
blurb: Pakistan’s port city of twenty million, supplied by a single utility, with sea breezes and long humid evenings.
